14. **Legends.** The narrator's legends grow from the "follow this character" view into biographies of characters, histories of tablets and the rise and fall of courts, and when a game ends the record opens to every seat, every hidden fact with it ("The narrator illuminates; it never steers" and "Legends, read from the record" under Spectator mode). With them the two echoes kept for the chronicle: "A new Idrimi", when a character rises from an outlaw band to rule a city, and Finkel's "I love you my gold owning brother" as a rare letter from a greedy script king or a chronicle line when a king begs gold a third time ("Finkel's version").
